method_note: Prediction only, using supplied packet and general reasoning. Direct vocabulary projections are treated as weak positive-column clues, reversed for negative actual doses, not behavioral guarantees. Half-reference interventions receive uncertain semantic effects and dose-dependent coherence losses; unrelated token projections predict mostly absent persona traits. Body, anime/cute, and female lexical directions can transfer to assistant identity, with stronger transfer on identity prompts, weaker transfer on literal or attributed fiction tasks, and more style on social prompts. Pair effects mostly add with limited aligned synergy and extra disruption. Joint forecasts use positively associated role adoption bounded by each marginal, not independence. No generations, external information, or historical results were consulted.
